mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit to build an outdoor bar in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: For outdoor bar construction in Los Angeles, a permit is often required, especially if the project involves plumbing, electrical work, gas lines, or significant structural changes. Even minor additions might require approval if they alter existing structures or utility connections. It's crucial to verify specific requirements with the Los Angeles Department of Building and Safety.
